scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:integration: sh -c 'docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait && trap "docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v" EXIT; DATABASE_URL=postgresql://roadmap_test_user:roadmap_test_password@localhost:5433/roadmap_test_db prisma migrate deploy && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://roadmap_test_user:roadmap_test_password@localhost:5433/roadmap_test_db prisma db seed && NEXTAUTH_SECRET=integration-nextauth-secret VTI_JWT_SECRET=integration-vti-secret VTI_JWT_ISSUER=https://vti.example.test VTI_JWT_AUDIENCE=u-roadmaps NEXT_PUBLIC_VTI_LOGIN_URL=https://vti.example.test/login DATABASE_URL=postgresql://roadmap_test_user:roadmap_test_password@localhost:5433/roadmap_test_db tsx --test tests/roadmap-completion.integration.ts tests/roadmap-editor.integration.ts tests/roadmap-api.integration.ts tests/vti.unit.ts tests/development-data.command.test.ts'
scripts.test:e2e: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://roadmap_e2e_user:roadmap_e2e_password@localhost:5435/roadmap_e2e_db NEXTAUTH_SECRET=e2e-nextauth-secret VTI_JWT_SECRET=e2e-vti-secret VTI_JWT_ISSUER=https://vti.example.test VTI_JWT_AUDIENCE=u-roadmaps NEXT_PUBLIC_VTI_LOGIN_URL=https://vti.example.test/login sh -c 'docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml up -d --wait && trap "docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml down -v" EXIT; prisma migrate deploy && prisma db seed && tsx tests/e2e/seed.ts && playwright test'
scripts.prisma:prepare: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && prisma db seed
